narr: Scattered thunderstorms formed across northern Indiana during the afternoon and evening hours. Many exhibited weak rotation and some funnel clouds but did not produce severe weather. However, a slow steering flow and persistent outflow boundary across the South Bend/Mishawaka area caused areas of flooding and for a brief window flash flooding as over four inches of rain fell over several hours. Some rescues were needed due to drivers misjudging the amount of water on roadways.
ev: Two to over four inches of rain fell over a 3 hour period, with many roads on the east side of South Bend and west side of Mishawaka experiencing high water in some areas. A few instances of road closures occurred due to flowing water up to a foot high. Several cars were stranded with at least 1 person having to be rescued after driving into flooded areas. Several manhole covers were reported removed as sewer systems overflowed.
